verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is an API-backed data platform, so a webhook subscription story is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only pull-based GET APIs and an option to receive an extract download URL by email ('emailId=Yes'). Email delivery is an adjacent notification, not a registrable outbound HTTP callback, and nothing in the pack shows webhook registration or event subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
